name: Marian Titles and Devotions
note: Organizing hub collective for the historic titles, devotional images, and approved apparitions of the Blessed Virgin Mary across Catholic and Eastern devotion; not a separate figure.

name: Our Lady of the Rosary
note: Marian title tied to the Dominican Rosary devotion (trad. ascribed to St Dominic); feast (orig. Our Lady of Victory) instituted by Pius V after Lepanto, 1571; attested in Counter-Reformation Catholic devotion and liturgy.

name: Our Lady of Mount Carmel
note: Patronal title of the Carmelite Order, linked to the trad. 1251 vision of St Simon Stock and the Brown Scapular; feast 16 July; attested in medieval Carmelite tradition and Mariology.

name: Brown Scapular of Our Lady of Mount Carmel
note: Carmelite sacramental devotion (the scapular), trad. given by Our Lady of Mount Carmel to St Simon Stock (1251); a devotional object/practice rather than a figure; attested in Carmelite and Counter-Reformation devotion.

name: Our Lady of Sorrows
note: Marian title (Mater Dolorosa) contemplating the Seven Sorrows of Mary; medieval devotion fostered by the Servite Order; feast 15 September; attested in medieval and modern Catholic Mariology.

name: Our Lady of Perpetual Help
note: Marian title centered on a Cretan-Byzantine icon (15th c.) entrusted by Pius IX to the Redemptorists (1866); widely diffused modern devotion; attested in icon history and Catholic Mariology.

name: Our Lady of Częstochowa (the Black Madonna)
note: Venerated icon at the Jasna Góra monastery, Częstochowa, Poland; the 'Black Madonna,' national palladium of Poland; crowned 1717; attested in Polish religious history and Mariology.

name: Our Lady of Walsingham
note: English Marian shrine at Walsingham, Norfolk, founded after a vision of Richeldis de Faverches (trad. 1061); major medieval pilgrimage, suppressed at the Reformation, revived 20th c.; attested in English ecclesiastical history.

name: Our Lady of Loreto
note: Marian title attached to the Holy House of Loreto (Marche, Italy), trad. translated from Nazareth; namesake of the Litany of Loreto; patroness of aviators; attested in medieval and modern Catholic devotion.

name: Our Lady of Mercy (Mercedes)
note: Marian title (Our Lady of Ransom / la Merced) tied to the founding of the Mercedarian Order by St Peter Nolasco (1218) for ransoming captives; feast 24 September; attested in medieval Iberian Catholic devotion.

name: Our Lady of Akita
note: Reported apparitions/locutions and a weeping statue to Sr. Agnes Sasagawa, Akita, Japan (1973); declared worthy of belief by the local bishop (1984); attested in modern Catholic apparition reports.

name: Our Lady of Zeitoun
note: Mass-witnessed luminous apparitions over the Coptic Orthodox Church of the Virgin in Zeitoun, Cairo (1968-71); approved by the Coptic Orthodox Patriarchate; attested in Coptic and broader Marian sources.
